Additional comments:

questions.answer: It was okay, there were some confusing about the documents i needed to bring to be able to check in to my dormitory

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: There were several dormitories

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Only some of the dormitories had kitchens, so the only other option for people living in dormitories that didnt have kitchens were the school cafeteri or restaurants around the school

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Be aware that there is rules im the dormitories and that they change depending on the dormitory, some have curfew for example

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
It was small, and not cleaned upon arrival, we werent told to get sheets so we had to figure that out on the day of check in.
The rent was cheap, so definetly a very cheap option for housing

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Exchange students were on the same level as students of the institution. It was difficult to find classes you liked and were taught in English. Some classes said they were taught in English but wasnt.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
Website only applikation, had 5 days in august to apply to classes.
In the first week of classes it was possible to drop and they other classes.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The international student office

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Not at all

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Registrer as soon as you can. And be aware of which classes are taught in English, write to the professor if possible.

Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: A lot more strict in terms of attendance

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

Korean english translation
US, China and Korea international relations
Digital media in translation

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The translation courses were fun
